title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库包含由Fernando Amaral教授讲授的完整人工智能培训课程，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等主题，提供理论讲解和Python实践项目。
summary_en: Repository for the Complete AI Training course by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering ML, DL, LLMs, GenAI, NLP, Agents, Computer Vision, Anomaly Detection, Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic, with theory and hands-on Python projects.
